product_one_liner.value: Malachyte helps ecommerce retailers personalize search, recommendations and merchandising in real time using shopper behavior and intent.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer, and the pricing endpoint did not expose a pricing page or plans.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage with case-study links.

eng_blog.notes: The blog links to one clearly qualifying engineer-authored infrastructure article on Google Cloud; the other reviewed posts are product, business or company commentary rather than a second qualifying engineering post.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes headless setup, click tracking, portal basics, and brands and subdomains.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page states: "There are no open positions right now."

model_provider.value: Malachyte's own proprietary two-headed transformer model
model_provider.notes: The CEO describes a slower head learning long-term taste and a second head adapting continuously to the current session.

compliance_certs.notes: The technology page claims SOC II Type 1 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026; co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Gradient Ventures, with participation from Harpoon Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round was announced August 6, 2026, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page states that there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: In the August 10, 2026 interview, the CEO reported Merchandising Studio as a major addition, giving business teams no-code control over the live model; its exact go-live date was not specified.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Di Lyngholm, VP of Product & Growth, moved full-time to Malachyte in April 2026 after starting as a consultant in August 2025.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The GTM posting names HubSpot and Apollo as example tools to use and test; the pilot page names Salesforce as an integration signal. These do not establish a confirmed internally deployed CRM stack.
